invariant: v1 supports standard GIL-enabled CPython 3.12/3.13 FastAPI on macOS/Linux only
v1 is for local development and test environments, not production debugging
Replay happens after the real request finishes and never pauses or slows the target process
Only backend HTTP request entry points are visualized in v1
Visualization drills down to function/class level and does not show line-by-line execution flow
v1 shows args/return summaries on spans but creates no ValueRef or ValueEdge tables
UI/API bind only to 127.0.0.1 and require startup-token plus Host/Origin controls
One project-scoped Python sidecar uniquely owns UI/API/SQLite while the business process runs only the SDK
Sidecar SQLite uses WAL and writes through one bounded serialized queue
Only graceful shutdown within a bounded timeout promises flush of accepted events
CodeNode stable_key does not include line numbers
Runtime spans record source hash; Phase 2 emits drift signals and old traces show source-changed without mutating tracepoints
Stable function tracing is OTel route mapping plus explicit @flowsight.trace functions
v1 does not implement or accept include_packages auto-wrapping; business functions require explicit @flowsight.trace
Tracepoints only support executable statement lines
Tracepoint capture semantics are before the target line executes
Tracepoints capture specified variable names only and never arbitrary expressions
Every persisted runtime value is a safe summary rather than a raw Python object or raw sensitive text
Redaction and depth/size/element/total limits run before SDK enqueue or process crossing
Interpreter-wide global tracing is forbidden
Secret-like names including password/token/secret/auth/cookie/session/API-key shapes are redacted
Timeline playback controls affect only UI replay and never the running application
Non-goal support requires an explicit scope override and user approval before implementation
v1 supports one active business producer; multi-worker registration is explicitly rejected
OTel FastAPI server spans supply trace/span identity; FlowSight creates no duplicate root and does not replace user providers/exporters
Trace collection exposes collecting/complete/incomplete and never presents dropped data as complete
Log collection and query are v1.1 experimental rather than v1 acceptance
Stable v1 static edges are contains/imports/route mapping; function calls come from runtime spans
Safe summaries never invoke unknown repr/properties/iterators/custom serializers
init_app alone guarantees HTTP/infrastructure spans while business function paths require explicit @flowsight.trace
The bundled UI runs from the Python wheel without Node.js on the end-user machine
SDK/sidecar queues are bounded and drops/storage errors are visible and mark traces incomplete
No tracepoint backend/function shape is stable until TRIAL-005 records a go decision
Phase 4 consumes CodeNode drift signals and marks existing tracepoint bindings stale until explicit reconfirmation
Explicit @flowsight.trace exports identity/timing/status code only; OTel exception capture/status description are disabled and args/return/safe exception detail stay private
FlowSight request_trace_id identifies one local server request; spans remain unique by otel_trace_id plus span_id so one upstream trace cannot merge multiple local requests
